meaning: Historical registration and extraction metadata for adopted preview pixels. Build from ../processing.json and ../sprites/.

base.processing: 保留原图；移除 alpha<128 边缘及不足16像素的孤立碎点。按实际透明沟槽分帧；无直线沟槽时按互不相连的alpha人物轮廓分离，掩去邻格轮廓；每张源图固定缩放，支撑点注册。不使用姿势形变或插值。

gait-lab.processing: 保留原图；测量透明沟槽，必要时按独立alpha轮廓分帧；源图固定缩放；按头部水平轴与支撑鞋底注册，无姿势形变或插值。

sleep-lab.processing: Authored image_gen poses; alpha cleanup, transparent-gutter partition, one fixed scale per source sheet, body-center/floor registration, atlas export. No pose deformation or interpolated frames.

air-lab.processing: Authored image_gen poses; alpha cleanup, transparent-gutter partition, one fixed scale per source sheet, fixed source grid registration in the air and body-center/floor registration on the ground, atlas export. No pose deformation or interpolated frames.

whale-landing-v1.partition: 12 separate alpha-connected silhouettes in reading order

whale-air-v1.partition: 12 separate alpha-connected silhouettes in reading order
